nodes.name: Lookup Modality Rows
nodes.notes: Fetch all active real-tier rows for the requested modality. The step-down (one tier below per REAL_TIERS) is computed in Resolve Below, the sole owner of the ordering.

parameters.query:
select impact, litellm_model, max_tokens, temperature
from model_routing
where modality = $1 and active = true
  and impact in ('Niski','Średni','Wysoki','Krytycznie ważne');

nodes.name: Resolve Below
nodes.notes: Sole owner of the step-down rule. REAL_TIERS is capability ascending. Returns the row one tier below the given impact, or { floor: true } at Niski/unknown (no lower tier).
